svg.aria-label: One takeover from the recorded run. o0 stops sending heartbeats while it holds the root. After 5 missed beats the log says it is dead. Each of the three who could inherit computes hash(root, member) on its own, and all three get o1 0.898, o2 0.252, o3 0.242, so all three name o1. o1 adopts the root and the others re-attach to it. The events are in the hash-chained log. No election, and no LLM call.

g.text: THE LOG: EVERY EVENT CARRIES THE HASH OF THE ONE BEFORE
One rule, one log. No election, and no LLM call.
